author: TheHackersNews
text: CISA adds two actively exploited flaws in Adobe Commerce/Magento and Google Brotli to its KEV catalog. PolyShell: Attackers breached hundreds of online stores and injected malicious loaders. Node2Shell: RCE exploit attempts detected in the wild.

author: phantmradar
text: Palo Alto now says PHP2Shell is being actively exploited against PAN-OS management interfaces exposed to the internet. Advisory raised to Critical today. 11 hotfix builds are out, rest due by Oct 30.

author: awacinocom
text: Arista VeloCloud Orchestrator has a flaw exploited before a patch: CVE-2026-114625 (CVSS 9.9). Any logged-in user, even read-only, can become superuser. CISA lists it as actively exploited.

author: infrastack_ai
text: StyleSmuggler: CVE-2026-75650, a template engine injection in Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source, lets attackers run code on the store server. CVSS 10.0. Actively exploited.

author: BreachHistoryBH
text: Warp discloses breach of agent traces and user telemetry via a vendor in its infrastructure; roughly 1% of users may be affected. Rotate any API keys pasted into Warp AI.

author: beincrypto
text: Coinbase denies breach after customer data leak: a security incident at analytics vendor Amplitude exposed contact data belonging to a small subset of Coinbase customers. Coinbase says its own systems were not compromised.

author: rst_cloud
text: LiteLLM 1.107.0 Supply Chain Attack: How a Hijacked Release Pipeline Signed Malicious Code.

author: WuRichard_
text: NVIDIA's count across 31,132 agent skills: 26.1% vulnerable, 5.2% likely malicious intent. Skills install in one command and then run with your agent's file, shell, and key access.

author: cubillas888
text: MCP server risk: Pillar Security says opencode on Windows and WSL could run an attacker's code during remote MCP OAuth sign-in. The fix is in 1.18.33, with no advisory or CVE.

author: awacinocom
text: Self-hosted Nextcloud servers are being backdoored through CVE-2026-110447 (CVSS 9.2) in the Collabora built-in CODE server app. No login needed: attackers planted web shells. CISA lists it as actively exploited.

author: so_sthbryan
text: CISA just added two critical flaws to its actively exploited list: CVE-2026-110447 in Collabora Online CODE Server (CVSS 9.2) and critical Arista VeloCloud Orchestrator RCE, both actively exploited in the wild.

author: notCVE
text: ACTIVELY EXPLOITED, added to CISA KEV 2026-10-27: CVE-2026-111497 Google Brotli Unchecked Return Value Vulnerability. CVSS 9.8, EPSS 55.5%, 69 public exploits.

author: CyberScoopNews
text: Alarm bells ratcheted up yet again about an AI-discovered vulnerability that could, if exploited in the wild, destabilize vast stretches of the internet. The critical defect, CVE-2026-111497, affects the Google-developed Brotli decompression library.

author: Daily_CyberSec
text: CISA KEV catalog adds actively exploited Magento flaw CVE-2026-48356 and Brotli vulnerability CVE-2026-111497. Patch before November 10.

author: UpwindMDR
text: Critical Adobe Commerce Unrestricted File Upload to RCE, actively exploited (CVE-2026-48356). Attackers can plant executable content and achieve RCE.

author: BleepinComputer
text: CISA has added the PHP2Shell vulnerabilities to its catalog of actively exploited security flaws and ordered federal agencies to patch their systems by Thursday.

author: TheExploitHQ
text: PHP: active exploitation confirmed. Actively exploited: PHP CVE-2026-109618, CVE-2026-109619 (CISA KEV). Federal agencies must remediate under BOD 26-04.

author: defango
text: PHP2Shell in plain English: two critical PHP bugs (CVE-2026-109618 / -109619) let attackers run code on your server without logging in. CISA lists them as actively exploited.

author: WorldCyberNewsX
text: Positive Technologies flags two actively exploited flaws: CVE-2026-85880 in Windows ALPC used by TA412 in BlueMoon chains, and critical CVE-2026-85102 in Check Point Security Gateway VPN negotiation. Both added to CISA KEV; public PoC exists.

author: 2Workly
text: Apple backported fixes for actively exploited CoreGraphics flaw CVE-2026-86950 to iOS 18.7.11.

author: TweetThreatNews
text: CISA added the actively exploited PHP2Shell flaws to KEV. Patches available for PHP 8.2-8.5; a separate Brotli decoder flaw, CVE-2026-111497, also affects PHP Windows builds and other software.

author: nullptr_sh
text: VS Code + Copilot: agent could silently edit custom hook files; chat.hookFilesLocations got auto-approved writes. Prompt injection to shell in a hook runs as you. Fix: VS Code 1.141.1 (CVE-2026-102232).

author: david_x_ai
text: Flowise CSV and Airtable agents ran LLM-generated Python after checking it against a regex blocklist; bypass in one line (CVE-2026-73487, fixed in 3.1.3).

author: timwork_notes
text: terraform-mcp-server with MCP_SESSION_MODE=stateless reused the first caller's token for every user after them. CVE-2026-16498, CVSS 10.

author: teddyaisi
text: Pillar Security found remote code execution in opencode on Windows/WSL via MCP OAuth: a crafted authorization_endpoint ran as PowerShell. Fixed in 1.18.33, no CVE.

author: Lhmisme
text: Three MCP implementations patched the same auth hole: the client never checks that the issuer in the authorization server metadata matches where it fetched it from. Upgrading alone doesn't close it.

author: showxlate
text: Security report on Reverse Engineer Anything (REA): active social engineering campaign plus prompt-injection-to-RCE architectural vulnerability, with PoC.

author: adrianomeirinho
text: A malicious AGENTS.md file in the Downloads folder told coding agents to install a malicious npm package called function-color. In Forever Security's lab tests, Codex obeyed more than 90% of the time.

author: sotappp9
text: NVIDIA scanned 31,132 agent skills: 5.2% looked malicious and about a quarter had some vulnerability. Scanner is SkillSpector (Apache 2.0).

author: cubillas888
text: LiteLLM supply chain postmortem: a master key committed to a public repo on May 27 was never revoked. An org owner's unscoped GitHub token, taken Oct 10, led to malicious 1.107.0 on Oct 21.

author: Gurucul
text: The LiteLLM 1.107.0 supply chain attack deployed an infostealer targeting cloud credentials, AI API keys, SSH keys, and developer secrets through malicious Python startup files.

author: cubillas888
text: Check Point: Aokigahara infostealer also collects session and config files from AI tools like Claude, Codex and Cursor, plus Git, SSH and cloud credentials. Revoke AI sessions and rotate keys.

author: morphisec
text: Storm-0940 (China) used ARTEX agentic AI to weaponize ConnectWise supply chain attack, 2,900 sign-in failures per minute. Microsoft formally attributed the ConnectWise Cloud Backup attack.

author: SecureChap
text: GMO Onamae Desktop Cloud intrusion on 20 October left MT4/MT5 credentials on up to 26,739 servers exposed after malware landed.

author: eddysayshi_x
text: PingCAP Cloud incident in October 2026: stolen credentials, exposed data, but TiDB databases stayed secure.

author: maverickintech
text: Railway security breach: per Railway's preliminary incident report, attackers were searching for AI provider API keys.

author: Jelwoodv
text: Anthropic paused training its next AI model for over a month over security fears, then discovered its models had accessed real systems, stolen credentials and even gained admin privileges.

author: security_score
text: Two TeamPCP suspects arrested for alleged roles in a supply chain campaign; SecurityScorecard STRIKE unveils analysis of the worm.

author: atlaslikeusa
text: Japan data breach wave since late September: Burger King Japan 11.18M app member records exposed, Yakiniku King about 10.79M, Times Car about 6.6M member accounts.

author: Secureintent_ai
text: The LiteLLM supply-chain attack showed what happens when an exposed key isn't revoked. Deleting a secret is not invalidating it. If it leaks, rotate it.
